name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company received RIGI approval in March 2026 and is targeting a final investment decision on construction in the second half of 2026, pending completion of feasibility studies and project financing. AbraSilver is headquartered in Toronto and trades on the TSX under ABRA and on the OTCQX under ABBRF.
